definitions.explanation: The non-physical essence of a person believed to survive after death. Used in religious, spiritual, and philosophical contexts to refer to the soul or spirit of the deceased.

examples.japanese: {霊魂|れいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{存在|そんざい}→存在：03326_sonzai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{信|しん}じます→信じる：01111_shinjiru⟧⟦か→か：09473_ka⟧。
examples.english: Do you believe in the existence of the soul?

examples.japanese: ⟦{古代|こだい}→古代：05324_kodai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{人々|ひとびと}→人々：03141_hitobito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{霊魂|れいこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{離|はな}れる→離れる：02397_hanareru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{考|かんが}えた→考える：00856_kangaeru⟧。
examples.english: Ancient people believed that the soul departed from the body.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{霊魂|れいこん}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{死後|しご}→死後：21150_shigo⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦この{世|よ}→この世：10334_konoyo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{留|とど}まる→留まる：10415_todomaru⟧こと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{言|い}われている→言う：00515_iu⟧。
examples.english: In Japan, it is said that the soul sometimes remains in this world after death.

notes:
USAGE:
{霊魂|れいこん} is a formal, literary word for the soul or spirit. In everyday conversation, ⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧ or ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧ is more common. {霊魂|れいこん} appears frequently in discussions of religion, philosophy, and traditional beliefs.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {霊魂|れいこん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{不滅|ふめつ}→不滅：15254_fumetsu⟧ (immortality of the soul)
- {霊魂|れいこん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{宿|やど}る→宿る：12351_yadoru⟧ (for a soul to dwell)
- {霊魂|れいこん}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{鎮|しず}める→鎮める：29400_shizumeru⟧ (to pacify a spirit)

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦{魂|たましい}→魂：14639_tamashii⟧: soul, spirit (more common)
- ⟦{霊|れい}→霊：14667_rei⟧: spirit, ghost
- ⟦{亡霊|ぼうれい}→亡霊：11473_bourei⟧: ghost of the dead
